required_steps: replay the proposed mechanism against frozen drift cases
review creativity costs and false-positive risks
activate by an explicit version-controlled human decision

mechanisms.guards_against: Chronological logs or retired policies silently becoming the current agenda.
mechanisms.rule: Read the charter, portfolio, current status, and canonical theory before selecting sustained work; historical logs are evidence, not authority.
mechanisms.creative_boundary: Free exploration may begin anywhere, but it cannot become the agenda merely because it was the last note written.

mechanisms.boundary: admission of a sustained research program
mechanisms.guards_against: Local hill-climbing through indefinitely extensible instances and carrier variants.
mechanisms.rule: Compare the proposal with the whole live portfolio and name its mission-level terminal outcome, scope, and redirection condition.
mechanisms.creative_boundary: Examples and narrow lemmas remain welcome in workspaces; only sustained resource commitment is compared globally.

mechanisms.guards_against: Spending research effort inside a published classified region or repeating known work as discovery.
mechanisms.rule: User-supplied prior-art facts and discovered controlling sources halt promotion until checked against primary sources and propagated to affected claims.
mechanisms.creative_boundary: Reading, reproduction, and benchmark work remain possible when labeled as such.

mechanisms.guards_against: Promoting a known support under a new coordinate representation or internal identifier.
mechanisms.rule: Canonicalize and compare every proposed support with the primary known-shape registry before novelty language or expensive follow-up.
mechanisms.creative_boundary: Blind rediscovery may still be retained as method validation after reclassification.

mechanisms.boundary: nontrivial computation and sustained evidence campaigns
mechanisms.guards_against: Adaptive escalation whose next run is justified only by the preceding finite result.
mechanisms.rule: Freeze the proposition, prior art, outcome meanings, command, wall time, artifact growth, and stop rule before launch.
mechanisms.creative_boundary: On-paper exploration and disposable scratch do not require proposals.

mechanisms.guards_against: Treating finite failure, solver exhaustion, or accumulated negative instances as a theorem.
mechanisms.rule: Resource stops and bounded evidence retain their exact three-valued status and cannot be promoted without a proof or independently checkable certificate.
mechanisms.creative_boundary: Signals may guide conjecture formation when quarantined from the certificate path.

mechanisms.boundary: use of external results in a proof or proposal
mechanisms.guards_against: Finding a formula somewhere in a source and attaching it to the wrong construction.
mechanisms.rule: Verify that the cited statement applies to the exact construction and hypotheses being used, not merely that matching text occurs in the paper.
mechanisms.creative_boundary: Unverified analogies may remain explicit conjectural prompts.

mechanisms.guards_against: Confusing an intended assembly or decoder with the language of every tiling of the support.
mechanisms.rule: Run the exact periodicity gate immediately and require complete contact, grouping, reflection, and total-decoder obligations before Einstein promotion.
mechanisms.creative_boundary: Attractive patches remain useful examples but carry no promotion status.
